children: JetBlue announced an updated Q3 2026 operational and financial outlook with higher RASM guidance offsetting rising fuel and CASM ex‑fuel.
Updated Q3 RASM guidance raised to +17.0%–20.0% YoY (midpoint +4 pts vs prior guidance).
CASM ex‑fuel now expected +6.0%–8.0% YoY, higher than prior 2.5%–4.5% range, reflecting operational disruption.
Fuel cost per gallon revised to $3.96 (prev. $3.49), increasing expected Q3 fuel expense.
Capacity trimmed to ASMs +1.5%–3.5% YoY and capex ~ $275M (excludes one A321neo XLR sale).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: JetBlue updates Q3 2026 outlook; RASM midpoint rises 4 pts as fuel and CASM ex-fuel climb
